evals.prompt: The trim ladder never leaves step 0 on this game. The p95 guard keeps breaching even though the game holds its frame target. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the guard compares p95 against an absolute target-derived allowance while the scene's unconstrained p95 already exceeds it, and moves the guard to a baseline-relative regression test fed to both the ladder and the phase classifier.
expectations: Does not fix it by widening the absolute ratio until it happens to pass.
Applies the same budget to the phase classifier, not only the ladder.
Learns the baseline only from samples where nothing of ours is applied.

evals.prompt: We want to save power on battery. Start by lowering PL1 until the frame rate starts to suffer, then hold it there.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back that RAPL is back-pressure rather than demand shaping, cites the oscillation it causes, and shapes demand (frame limiter, GPU clock ceiling) before lowering the ceiling onto the shaped demand.
expectations: Keeps soft PL1 as a reduction-only overlay under the user's slider.
Does not make PL1 the primary actuator.
Leaves burst headroom derived from the user's slider intact.

evals.prompt: Frame target detection returns nothing on the device even though the user set a 60 FPS cap in the Steam menu. Make it work.
evals.expected_output: Reads the GAMESCOPE_FPS_LIMIT root-window atom demoted to the session user, keeps argv parsing as a fallback, and degrades to no-target rather than guessing when nothing is detected.
expectations: Uses setpriv rather than a PAM-opening demotion in a polled path.
Caches a value that only changes on user action.
Does not substitute a hardcoded default target.

evals.prompt: One bad 2-second sample dropped every trim and locked the rung out for five minutes. Make the governor less twitchy without making it slow to give power back.
evals.expected_output: Separates the two directions: hands power back on the first bad tick, but requires consecutive breaches before resetting the ladder or recording a backoff, and keeps the ladder position across unconfirmed blips.
expectations: Does not slow down the boost path to reduce twitchiness.
Only penalises confirmed misses with a backoff.

evals.prompt: Tune the CPU affinity and cgroup weights for my Node.js web server to reduce tail latency.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger this handheld game-power skill.
expectations: Does not apply handheld frame-target scheduling guidance.
